summary: Eight-metre scrap of kerb in trees beside Discovery Drive; no room for a van.
reasons: Under trees beside a main road

drivers.seclusion: Dwelling about 17 m south; trees screen the spot but the stretch is too short to use.
drivers.access_and_room: Only 8 m long, wedged between a chevron-marked island and trees; nowhere to pull fully off.
drivers.traffic: Beside the multi-lane Discovery Drive with no parked cars.
drivers.convention: No parking convention; No Stopping sign mapped right at the kerb.

flags: No Stopping Any Time sign within 1 m
Steep: about 13% mean grade on the DEM
sun_shade: Under dense tree canopy, shaded all day.
